name: עֵדֶר
summary: Chronicles names a Levite son of Mushi and a Benjaminite in the family of Beriah.

evidence.note: Eder is the second of Mushi’s three named sons.
The roster of Levites repeats the name.
The Benjaminite appears beside Zebadiah and Arad.

note: The Levite’s name matches the flock noun. The Benjaminite also has the pointing עֶדֶר in the lexical index. Neither genealogy explains the name.
